summary_metadata.primary_focus: A citable scrape plan combining public NFL play-by-play and roster/transaction releases, StatsBomb event and 360 data, sportsbook and pick-em competitor surfaces, exchange/orderbook APIs, and transparent model methodology pages. The targets prioritize raw schemas, release loaders, market identifiers, feature definitions and public engineering code over generic landing pages.
